Why trust CRI

Built like a reference institution, governed like one

Independent

Editorial decisions are made solely by our editors, under public standards. Every relationship is disclosed.

Sourced, and honest about the gaps

Published pages list the documents behind them, and say plainly where the evidence runs out. Where our own data is not yet validated, we mark it and decline to publish a number rather than dress up a guess. See our methodology.

Accountable

Review dates on every page. Errors fixed in public under our corrections policy.
